annotations.title: Search open public tenders in the EU (paid)

description: Public procurement search (aanbestedingen, tenders) for sales and bid agents: open contract notices from TED, the EU's official tenders journal, by country, CPV code, keywords, deadline and minimum value, with English titles, buyer, deadline and estimated value. For the Netherlands it also returns national below-threshold tenders from TenderNed, which are not in TED. Cached 3 hours. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402, or 3 credits of a Factline API key.
